caption: The worked example as a chain: three servers in parallel lift availability to 0.999999, then the load balancer at 0.999 in series multiplies in and caps the service at 0.998999001, which is about 8.77 hours of downtime in a year. Notice the server group is far more available than the load balancer — the load balancer is the bottleneck.

spec.title: Servers in parallel, load balancer in series
spec.aria: Three servers each with availability 0.99 in parallel give a group availability of 1 minus 0.01 cubed, that is 0.999999; multiplied by the load balancer's 0.999 in series the service reaches 0.998999001, which leaves about 8.77 hours of downtime per year.
